label: KAT6A::CREBBP

sections.text: KAT6A encodes a histone acetyltransferase involved in hematopoietic stem-cell maintenance.
CREBBP encodes CBP, a transcriptional coactivator and histone acetyltransferase.

The fusion joins two acetyltransferase-associated transcriptional regulators, redirecting chromatin acetylation and leukemogenic gene expression. KAT6A fusions are associated with monocytic differentiation, erythrophagocytosis and sometimes disseminated intravascular coagulation.
Adult AML with KAT6A::CREBBP is assigned adverse ELN 2022 genetic risk. Congenital cases can have a distinct course, including reported spontaneous remissions.
